overall_freeze_blockers: arrival evaluator uses wall time while GOAL F requires 3.0 sim s
continuous full-body clearance margin not certified or budgeted
no end-to-end N15 fault detection/exit/landing-drift evidence
no N16 full-load resource/queue time series or numeric resource support
tracking candidate has no physics-based relation to clearance

policy.unknown: retain raw unknown; no raw-known-free whole-curve gate
policy.upstream_watchdogs: retained; record source and live effective value, do not duplicate as custom project gates

metrics.metric: truth-referenced full-body 3-D position and yaw at target, simultaneously and continuously
metrics.time_domain: Gazebo truth source stamp / simulation time; wall time is reported separately
metrics.reference: target transformed into world from one prestream rigid SE(3), scale=1; full-body IMU lever arm from model
metrics.method: independent read-only truth; require contiguous supported samples and reject gaps >0.04 sim s
evidence: GOAL.md §F.3 (contract)
N10 #376: reported 3.114 s independent dwell (time domain to be re-evaluated)
N10 #381: 3.055 wall s, only 2.34 sim s in the same joint-tolerance window
metrics.confidence: high for values; low for implementation compliance
metrics.open: Existing evaluator measures dwell in wall time. #361/#376/#381 do not yet demonstrate the required 3.0 continuous simulation seconds. Change evaluator and requalify the task runner before PASS.

metrics.metric: raw VINS IMU pose error over PRESTREAM-to-LANDED, plus goal-motion and hold segments
metrics.time_domain: VINS/Gazebo paired simulation stamps; retain wall support diagnostics
metrics.reference: one fixed prestream SE(3), scale=1; no route fit, segment refit, truth feedback, or timestamp repair
metrics.method: report RMSE/P50/P95/max globally and by phase; count paired coverage and maximum source gap
evidence: #376 position p95/max 0.407/0.423 m, yaw max 12.358 deg
metrics.open: Candidate bounds round above these three dissimilar runs; there is no frozen physical error budget or repeated same-profile error distribution. #381 target-relative hold drift exits 0.30 m after 226.096 sim s despite sub-0.50 m fixed-frame pose error. Do not treat the candidate as a runtime lockout.

metrics.metric: 10-second relative pose error; 1 s and 5 s remain diagnostic
metrics.reference: N01 same fixed-scale alignment and relative-pose calculation
metrics.method: P95 primary; report RMSE, max, candidate/support/rejected pair counts; insufficient if any unsupported time pairing masks the interval
evidence: #381 10 s translation P95/max 0.041668/0.099758 m; rotation P95/max 0.300459/0.495911 deg
#381 supported 10,054/10,054 pairs; zero rejected
metrics.confidence: medium for this profile; low across modes
metrics.open: Only one current full-route run uses the segmented N01-compatible evaluator; need independent repeats and evidence across obstacle/yaw modes before freezing. Max values remain diagnostic; the P95 candidate is not a safety guarantee.

metrics.metric: raw VINS world-frame twist.linear versus centered truth IMU velocity, split goal motion and exact hold
metrics.time_domain: simulation time; truth velocity centered over 0.2 sim s, no extrapolation
metrics.reference: VINS WORLD_FRAME_ID twist.linear rotated by the single prestream rigid alignment; D435i IMU truth reference point
metrics.method: vector norm error P95/max, sample support fraction and source gaps per mission phase
metrics.open: Only one long-route velocity capture. Bounds are offline measurement candidates, not commanded-speed caps or runtime guards; need an independent route repeat. Landing is excluded from goal/hold statistics and reported separately.

metrics.metric: maximum absolute raw occupancy surface-center error against SDF surface
metrics.time_domain: same-identity map snapshot source stamp; offline truth/SDF comparison
metrics.reference: raw occupancy centers; no truth input to online mapper, no alignment fitted using map points
metrics.method: per-layout/per-snapshot P95 and max; retain sample counts, false classes, unknown and identity
evidence: N04 two layouts, three snapshots each; 0.10 m voxel resolution
N04 cross-layout worst surface-center residual 0.09535 m, below one voxel; corridor snapshot 3 shifted 0.09821 m from snapshot 2
metrics.open: The one-voxel bound follows map resolution, not a physical collision budget. Raw free/occupied classification has retained outliers; no error-rate limit can be claimed from N04. Re-run after final clean build and in task layouts.

metrics.metric: raw occupancy classification by visible-free, surface-hit and truth-occluded ROI; raw unknown must remain distinct
metrics.reference: offline SDF line-of-sight and geometry; never feed truth back to mapping or planning
metrics.method: report confusion counts and ROI denominator; don't collapse unknown into free; official_ego collision still uses inflated occupied
evidence: N04 both layouts: hidden ROI raw unknown 784/784 and 785/785 per snapshot, raw free 0
N04 visible free-ray false occupied ranged 0.01%-5.17%; surface-hit false occupied up to 100% on conflicting voxel votes
metrics.confidence: high that unknown is preserved in tested layouts; low for general classifier accuracy
metrics.open: No numeric acceptance rate for false occupied or surface classifications is supported. Preserve official_ego behavior; this row is an offline diagnostic, not a raw-free runtime rejection.

metrics.metric: fused-depth source-to-observation age and occupancy-update age (separate clocks/fields)
metrics.time_domain: ROS/Gazebo simulation stamps; never mix with steady-clock callback latency or PX4/HRT
metrics.reference: source header stamp, map update stamp and sample receipt stamp recorded independently
metrics.method: P95/max per run; additionally report callback-to-fusion steady seconds and exact max callback gap if available
evidence: #361 source/occupancy max 0.160/0.112 s
N04 source-to-fusion max 0.149 s, callback-to-complete max 0.0738 steady s
effective EGO odom_depth_timeout=0.4 sim s; upstream updateOccupancyCallback declares timeout; project-added source/receipt age refusals removed by patch 0054
metrics.confidence: medium for observed nominal range; native timeout semantics verified in source
metrics.open: 0.20 s is an offline candidate derived by rounding above the observed 0.168 s max; it adds no runtime gate. 0.40 s is the existing upstream occupancy-update timeout parameter, not a new project health threshold. Measure exact source/update ages and failure behavior after rebuild.

metrics.metric: READY PositionCommand to truth full-body IMU position at same source-time pairing
metrics.time_domain: simulation source time, same fixed prestream transform; report pairing/bracket gaps
metrics.reference: commanded EGO position transformed to world versus interpolated Gazebo IMU truth
metrics.method: P95/max by active segment; this is controller tracking response, separate from ATE/RPE and obstacle clearance
metrics.open: The 0.60/1.20 values are rounded margins over observed samples, not a collision-safe budget. The existing 0.15 m candidate check was explicitly not formal. Need correlate tracking excursion with measured swept clearance and obstacle/turning profiles; no runtime cap or rejection is added.

metrics.metric: PX4 horizontal-speed caller-cancel to 1 s confirmed stop-band entry; true horizontal path length
metrics.time_domain: PX4 reported trigger-speed sample and PX4/run sim timestamps; truth path uses Gazebo sim samples
metrics.reference: caller-cancel acknowledgement to truth-referenced full-body interval; stop-band definition preserved in #378 protocol
metrics.method: all three independent cold starts; report speed, vertical velocity, ego reference speed, delay, path/displacement, dwell and source gaps
evidence: stop-band entry 4.844/4.880/5.116 sim s; 1.004–1.020 sim s dwell; prohibited contact 0 each
metrics.confidence: medium for exact caller-cancel protocol/profile; low outside it
metrics.open: Not a maximum flight speed or runtime speed guard. This narrow stop measurement does not combine the planner's .7306 m inflated obstacle clearance or certify reaction-to-collision safety; require actual-swept clearance evidence for each scene. Do not extrapolate above 0.66 m/s or to other fault triggers.

metrics.metric: minimum full-body swept clearance to every prohibited collision plus contact-event count
metrics.time_domain: Gazebo truth simulation time; full propeller-swept geometry and attitude
metrics.reference: SDF obstacle collision geometry and full x500+D435i body envelope; evaluate actual trajectory, not planned centerline
metrics.method: continuous or mathematically conservative interval bound; independently confirm zero prohibited contacts; allowed skid/ground contacts phase-scoped
evidence: #361 static adjusted sampled lower bound 0.33791 m
#376 static 0.10759 m and dynamic-box 0.81289 m
#381 whole-scene adjusted sampled 0.26225 m and box 0.83908 m; zero prohibited contacts in #361/#376/#381
metrics.confidence: high for zero logged events in these runs; low for continuous clearance bound
metrics.open: Current evaluator subtracts observed inter-sample motion but does not bound unobserved attitude/trajectory motion. Planner inflation .73062 m is body radius plus map/RPE/voxel/sample terms and explicitly excludes tracking, latency, braking, accessories and vibration. Need close budget without double counting; no positive numeric clearance margin is presently justified.

metrics.metric: obstacle acknowledgement to first replacement trajectory that clears full-body envelope, and whether actual path remains collision-free
metrics.time_domain: Gazebo create acknowledgement/map source/trajectory receipt stamps in one sim epoch
metrics.reference: dynamic 0.8 x 0.8 x 2.8 m box and actual observed trajectory; distinguish any replacement from first clear replacement
metrics.method: report first candidate, first clear candidate, occupied observation, source/update age, time-to-obstacle, actual clearance/contact and safe terminal state
evidence: #376 first clear-by-radius spline +0.552 sim s; #381 first recorded clear replacement spline +0.536 sim s; both single current-profile scenarios
metrics.open: 1.0 s is a rounded observation candidate, not a sufficient collision-response deadline absent distance-to-obstacle and stopping budget; N13 needs multi-obstacle and actual-clearance evidence. N10.4 evaluator must not treat a merely new but intersecting spline as success.

metrics.metric: six GOAL E fault types: injection -> detection -> goal/trajectory invalidation -> motion/landing -> landed/disarmed final state
metrics.unit: fault-specific sim/wall/PX4-HRT domains; explicit per-event timeline
metrics.time_domain: separate injected fault source time, ROS sim time, wall monotonic time and PX4/HRT time; never compare raw clocks
metrics.reference: configuration/source and independent PX4/bridge readbacks; truth contact/pose only in debug_truth
metrics.method: six fault types x >=2 independent injections each per GOAL; report detection latency, last valid setpoint, invalidation, drift/clearance, land/disarm; keep failure records
evidence: source audit: map update watchdog 0.4 sim s; PX4 COM_OF_LOSS_T=1.0 (effective startup value still needs live readback); bridge clock-stall watchdog 15 wall s
N10 has no N15 fault-injection qualification evidence
metrics.open: Do not substitute component timer values for end-to-end fault response. Detection/landing drift/clearance and live effective PX4 action have not been measured. N15 supplies the required values; N10.4 must retain nulls and return INSUFFICIENT until then, so N10 cannot be finally frozen yet.

metrics.metric: one unbroken >=600 sim s full navigation/load run with goal, obstacle update/replan, resource/latency/queue timeseries, normal land/disarm
metrics.unit: sim seconds, CPU%, bytes, queue entries, per-stream age/latency units
metrics.time_domain: run sim stamps plus wall monotonic for RTF/host resource sampling
metrics.reference: actual frozen runtime composition, no stitched sessions; per-stream source, receipt and compute clocks stay distinct
metrics.method: continuously record CPU/memory/queue depth/end-to-end latency/VIO/map errors; inspect queue capacity and growth slope, terminal PX4 state
evidence: #361/#381 each 600 sim s ACTIVE hold but not a moving full-load obstacle/replan qualification
RTF 0.761/#361 and 0.764/#381; no CPU/memory series; no N16 run
metrics.open: The 600 s duration is the existing N16 contract. No justified CPU/memory or queue bound has been established for N16's full load; derive queue bounds from exact configured capacities and capture a continuous full-load trace after N10 freeze. Do not invent a host-relative numeric CPU/memory limit.
